Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan
Date: 01/27/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 76 as introduced proposes a Constitutional Amendment, that if ratified, would require the Governor to notify the Attorney General and all members of a victims family prior to granting a commutation or reprieve to persons sentenced to death.
This amendment could increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary
